• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

perks.name: Tunnel Vision
perks.description: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for a short duration.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: Heating Up
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon increase accuracy and stability while improving vertical recoil.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.description: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.description: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.description: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.description: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.description: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.description: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.description: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Osmosis
perks.description: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.description: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: One for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

Swords gain increased charge rate and guard resistance.

name: Service of Luzaku
flavorText: "This one made it for you. It brings death yet promises nothing beyond." —Luzaku

intrinsic.name: Dichotomous Thinking
intrinsic.description: Hitting targets with this weapon builds a restorative charge. Hip firing at allies while this weapon is charged heals them, does not expend ammo, and fills this weapon's magazine from reserves. Rapid healing increases weapon damage and spawns Threadlings from your allies.

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.description:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.description:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.description: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Ensemble
perks.description: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Sneak Bow
perks.description: Increases hold time and reload speed, and prevents radar pings from shooting while crouched.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.description: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.description: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.description: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.description:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.description: Arrows explode after a short delay.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Turnabout
perks.description: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.description: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.description: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.description: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Abundant Ammo
perks.description: Grants slightly increased ammo generation.

  •  Moderately controls recoil

An Exotic catalyst can be inserted into this socket.

Check the Exotic catalysts section in Triumphs to learn where the catalyst can be obtained.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. It will generate Orbs on multikills and gain a random bonus stat.

The weapon will also gain a tracker that displays the number of Crucible opponents defeated by using it.

• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of further increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

name: Theodolite
flavorText: The only number that matters is the distance between you and your target.

intrinsic.name: Micro-Missile Frame
intrinsic.description: This weapon fires a high-speed micro-missile in a straight line and deals reduced self-damage. Move faster with this weapon equipped.

originTraits.name: Problem Solver
originTraits.description:
Dealing sustained damage to Champion, miniboss, or boss combatants exhausts them and grants this weapon handling and reload speed.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

originTraits.name: Vanguard Determination
originTraits.description: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

originTraits.name: Field-Tested
originTraits.description:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed.

Swords gain increased charge rate and guard resistance.

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.description: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.description: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Tunnel Vision
perks.description: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for a short duration.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.description: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.description: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.description: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.description: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.description: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.description: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.description: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

perks.name: Osmosis
perks.description: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it.

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.description:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.description: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.description: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

intrinsic.name: Precision Frame
intrinsic.description: Recoil pattern on this weapon is predictably more vertical. Fires quickly with high accuracy. Move faster while aiming down sights with this weapon equipped.

originTraits.name: Gun and Run
originTraits.description: Defeating targets builds stacks of Gun and Run for a short duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this briefly improves draw speed.

Once enhanced, this weapon will be granted a weapon level, a Memento socket, and access to additional weapon mods.

Enhancing will immediately replace this weapon's Masterwork with an enhanced intrinsic that is aligned with the current Masterwork stat.

perks.name: Enhancement 2
perks.description: Upgrading this weapon to Enhancement 2 will update the left-column trait perk(s).

perks.name: Enhancement 3
perks.description: Upgrading this weapon to Enhancement 3 will update the right-column trait perk(s).

name: Whistler's Whim

originTraits.name: Alacrity
originTraits.description: Gain increased reload, stability, aim assist, and range when an ally is defeated. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.

originTraits.name: One Quiet Moment
originTraits.description: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

originTraits.name: Veist Stinger
originTraits.description: Damaging an enemy with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights. Bows receive faster draw speed and swords receive faster charge rate while this perk is active.

perks.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.description: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a short duration.

perks.description: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Enhancement 1
perks.description:
Once enhanced, this weapon will be granted a weapon level, a Memento socket, and access to additional weapon mods.

Enhancing will immediately replace this weapon's Masterwork with an enhanced intrinsic that is aligned with the current Masterwork stat.

perks.name: Enhancement 3
perks.description: Upgrading this weapon to Enhancement 3 will update the right-column trait perk(s).

perks.name: Vanguard Masterwork
perks.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. It will generate Orbs on multikills and gain a random bonus stat.

The weapon will also gain a tracker that displays the number of enemies defeated by using it.

perks.name: Crucible Masterwork
perks.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. It will generate Orbs on multikills and gain a random bonus stat.

The weapon will also gain a tracker that displays the number of Crucible opponents defeated by using it.
